parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Dear Document Owners,

This is a notification to inform you that a document requires a review. The document will expire in one month.

The Reviewers will be sent a Review approval task, this will allow them to comment on any changes, if needed. After 7 days (or as soon as all the responses are collected), another Approval task will be sent to you, the Document Owner, to do the Final Review.

Document No.: @{outputs('Get_file_properties_-_Document')?['body/Document_x0020_Number']}
Document Title: @{outputs('Get_file_properties_-_Document')?['body/Project_x0020_Title']}
Document Owner: @{outputs('Get_file_properties_-_Document')?['body/Document_x0020_Owner/DisplayName']}
Reviewers: @{variables('Reviewers')}


Power Automate Workflow: Docs - Draft Document - Request Review for this selected file
